newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-HENDRY HOLDS ON FOR FIFTH BRITISH TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-HENDRY HOLDS ON FOR FIFTH BRITISH TITLE.

text.p: Scot Stephen Hendry is still British snooker champion but only after the most dramatic final for years.
Hendry held his nerve to deny countryman John Higgins his first British title after a narrow 10-9 success before a capacity crowd in Preston on Sunday.
It was Hendry's third British championship in succession and fifth in all but he had to survive a stiff challenge from Higgins who fought back from 8-4 down to lead 9-8.
But Hendry, the world champion, levelled at 9-9, snookering Higgins behind the green and then making an 82 break off his opponent's attempted escape.
Higgins broke off in the decider and there seemed little danger. However, Hendry smacked in a long red to fashion a break of 77 in only eight minutes to take him to the winning post.
